evidence: Has Utils/log/libs label and primarily modifies shared logging infrastructure in src/util/log.h and src/logging.cpp.
rationale: Decouples logging macros from a single global logger instance by introducing context parameters to support multi-instance execution and isolated log capture. As noted in the description, the global log stream 'limits functionality of libbitcoinkernel, forcing all potential users of the library... to use shared global state', and resolving this unblocks PRs #30342 and #30343.
